name: vulnera
description: AI security agent for Indian builders: which vulnerable dependencies to fix first, why, in Hindi or English.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run build -w client
